say.en: Tellurium is heavier than iodine, yet Mendeleev placed it first. In 1913 Moseley's X-ray experiments showed why: the true order is by atomic number. In this lesson: State the modern periodic law.
Describe the long form of the periodic table.
Write IUPAC names and symbols for elements with Z is greater than 100.

body.en: Moseley found that the square root of the frequency of an element’s characteristic X-rays is proportional to its atomic number, not its atomic mass. *Modern periodic* law: the physical and chemical properties of the elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers. The long form of the periodic table has 7 periods (horizontal rows) and 18 groups (vertical columns).
body.kn: ಆಧುನಿಕ ಆವರ್ತಕ ನಿಯಮ: ಧಾತುಗಳ ಭೌತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಗುಣಗಳು ಅವುಗಳ ಪರಮಾಣು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಆವರ್ತಕ ಫಲನ. ದೀರ್ಘ ರೂಪದ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ 7 ಆವರ್ತಗಳು ಮತ್ತು 18 ಗುಂಪುಗಳಿವೆ.

title.en: Name an element from its atomic number

narration.en: Until a new element gets its permanent name, IUPAC names it from the digits of its atomic number: 0 nil, 1 un, 2 bi, 3 tri, 4 quad, 5 pent, 6 hex, 7 sept, 8 oct, 9 enn, followed by -ium. The symbol is made of the first letters of the roots. So Z = 120 is unbinilium, Ubn.
narration.kn: ಹೊಸ ಧಾತುವಿಗೆ ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಹೆಸರು ಸಿಗುವವರೆಗೆ IUPAC ಅದರ ಪರಮಾಣು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಅಂಕಿಗಳಿಂದ ಹೆಸರಿಡುತ್ತದೆ: 0 nil, 1 un, 2 bi, 3 tri, 4 quad, 5 pent, 6 hex, 7 sept, 8 oct, 9 enn, ನಂತರ -ium. ಸಂಕೇತ ಮೂಲಗಳ ಮೊದಲ ಅಕ್ಷರಗಳಿಂದ. ಹಾಗಾಗಿ Z = 120 unbinilium, Ubn.

say.en: Moseley found that the square root of the X-ray frequency of an element rises in a straight line with its atomic number, not its atomic mass.
Until a new element is named, IUPAC builds a temporary name from roots for each digit of Z, and adds ium.
Element 119 is un, un, enn: ununennium, symbol Uue. Element 120 is unbinilium, Ubn.

title.en: IUPAC names for elements with Z > 100

body.en: Until a new element’s name is approved, *IUPAC* gives a temporary name built from numerical roots for its digits: 0 nil, 1 un, 2 bi, 3 tri, 4 quad, 5 pent, 6 hex, 7 sept, 8 oct, 9 enn, followed by -ium. The symbol is the first letters of the roots. Z = 101 is unnilunium (Unu), now mendelevium (Md).

problem.en: Write the IUPAC name and symbol for the element with Z = 120.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Write the IUPAC name and symbol for the element with Z = 120.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Write the IUPAC name and symbol for the element with Z equals 120.
Digits: 1, 2, 0 gives un, bi, nil.
Add -ium: unbinilium.
Symbol: U plus b plus n equals Ubn.
So the answer is Unbinilium, Ubn.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Write the IUPAC temporary name and symbol for Z equals 109.
Digits: 1, 0, 9 gives un, nil, enn.
Add -ium: unnilennium.
Symbol: Une (now meitnerium, Mt).
So the answer is Unnilennium, Une.

body.en: Drop the final "n" of enn before nil (ennil, not ennnil), and drop the final "i" of bi and tri before -ium (bium, trium). Everything else is just roots joined together.
